cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_dropdown_button_styles_worker C CXX)
enable_testing()
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_executable(test_dropdown_button_styles "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_dropdown_button_styles.c")
target_link_libraries(test_dropdown_button_styles PRIVATE cui_software cui)
cui_warnings(test_dropdown_button_styles)
add_test(NAME dropdown_button_styles COMMAND test_dropdown_button_styles)
add_library(dropdown_button_styles_header OBJECT "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_dropdown_button_styles_header.cpp")
target_link_libraries(dropdown_button_styles_header PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(dropdown_button_styles_header)
file(READ "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/DROPDOWN_BUTTON_STYLES.md" guide)
string(REGEX MATCH "```c\n([^`]+)```" example "${guide}")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.c" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
add_library(dropdown_button_styles_guide OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.c")
target_link_libraries(dropdown_button_styles_guide PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(dropdown_button_styles_guide)
